Introduction
This document outlines the steps for replacing the generator air coolers, 3 coolers out of a total of 4 coolers
Technical Specifications of the Generator Air Coolers
Generator air cooler of Air water cross flow type, number of tubes 140 tubes, number of passes 8
Inner diameter 22 mm and outer diameter 24 mm, tube length 300 mm, finned
Air inlet temperature (65), air outlet temperature (40), test pressure 10 kg/cm2
Water flow rate 106 m3/hour
Water inlet temperature (35), water outlet temperature (42), test pressure 3 kg/cm2

Ensure that the unit on which the generator air coolers are to be replaced is shut down
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the maintenance crew must carry the occupational safety and health category card
Record the names of the workers in the work order and their occupational safety and health categories
Fence off the work area for the equipment and place the appropriate warning signs
Workers must wear occupational safety and health equipment while carrying out the work, such as helmet, gloves, masks and protective shoes
Tools and Equipment Used
Occupational safety and health equipment
Open-end wrench set from 19 to 27 mm
Winch, forklift and jack, special fixture for supports and slides
Wooden wedges, plugs, rubber gaskets and a water hose, with silicone available

sections_target.text: Procedures to be Carried Out
Preparations
Shutdown of the generating unit on whose air coolers the work is being carried out
Prepare the supports and slides
Prepare the winch for lowering the air coolers
Dismantle the water inlet and outlet flanges of the cooler after closing the valves
Dismantle the cooler cover, test the air coolers to be installed

items: Shutdown of the generating unit on whose air coolers the work is being carried out
Prepare the winch for lowering the air coolers
Dismantle the water inlet and outlet flanges of the cooler after closing the valves
Dismantle the cooler cover, test the air coolers to be installed

sections_target.text: Testing the Old Coolers
The cooler is loaded onto a stand, wedges are placed at one of the two ends, and all tubes are plugged
Inspect the tubes one by one and locate any leakage if present
After finishing testing all tubes and placing plugs in any tube with leakage from both sides, remove the wedges
Removing the Old Coolers and Installing the New Coolers

Install a special fixture consisting of a bar support reaching to below the cooler by about 2 inches, then fix the bars in special openings in the wall supporting the coolers, and place pipes on which the coolers slide
Pull the old cooler using a jack until it starts to load onto the pipes, then continue pulling it
The old cooler is loaded by the winch and placed in a safe place
Start loading the new cooler and placing it on the slides and then on the bars, taking into account its axial alignment and its place of installation
Insert the new cooler using the jack
Move the beams to the adjacent cooler, fix it, and remove the old cooler
Repeat the previous steps with the remaining coolers
Install the gaskets and fixing straps
Connect the water inlet and outlet connections, then place the cooler cover on the other side
It is put into service after opening the valve
